description: Defines the IApplication interface and related enums for application control and notifications within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IApplication
classes.description: Interface for application management including reset, launch point, visibility, language, and notifications.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for application visibility change notifications.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets application data based on specified reset type.

methods.name: ContentLink
methods.description: Gets or sets the URI of the application content.

methods.name: LaunchPoint
methods.description: Gets or sets the application launch point type.

methods.name: Visible
methods.description: Gets or sets the application's visibility status.

methods.name: Language
methods.description: Gets or sets the application's UI language.
